WITH member_attendance AS (
  SELECT 
    m.member_id,
    m.position,
    COUNT(*) as attendance_count
  FROM attendance a
  JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
),
total_attendance_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM attendance
)
SELECT 
  ma.member_id,
  ma.position,
  ma.attendance_count,
  ROUND(1.0 * ma.attendance_count / ta.total_count, 4) as share
FROM member_attendance ma
CROSS JOIN total_attendance_count ta
ORDER BY ma.attendance_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
